11.translated: ETAPA CASTILLO DE LA PRINCESA BUENA

intro_story.note: 5 filas x 28 celdas; texto en las filas 0, 2 y 4.

0.original: ONE EVENING, MICKEY FELL                               ASLEEP WHILE READING A BOOK                                   OF FAIRY TALES.
0.translated: UNA NOCHE, MICKEY CAYÓ                               DORMIDO LEYENDO UN LIBRO DE                                  CUENTOS DE HADAS.

1.original: WHEN HE WOKE UP, HE WAS NO                             LONGER IN HIS HOME, BUT IN A                             STRANGE AND GLOOMY VILLAGE.
1.translated: AL DESPERTARSE, YA NO ESTABA                              EN SU CASA, SINO EN UNA                                   ALDEA RARA Y OSCURA.

WITH THE CRYSTAL[FF]GONE, THE GOOD MAGIC IN THIS[FE]VALLEY HAS DISAPPEARED.[FD][FB][07]IN ITS PLACE, BAD MAGIC[FF]HAS CHANGED EVERYTHING. NOW,[FE]RATHER THAN BEING A PLACE OF[FD][FB][07]HAPPINESS, THE VALLEY IS[FF]FULL OF GLOOM. 1.original: [FB][07]A GOOD PRINCESS IN THE NORTH[FF]MOUNTAINS CAN TELL YOU HOW[FE]TO GET TO THE PHANTOM'S[FD][FF][FB][07]CASTLE IN THE CLOUDS.[FE][FC]
1.translated: [FB][07]UNA PRINCESA BUENA DEL NORTE[FF]PUEDE DECIRTE CÓMO LLEGAR AL[FE]CASTILLO EN LAS NUBES DEL[FD][FF][FB][07]FANTASMA.[FE][FC]

2.original: [FB][04]IF YOU PLANT THESE BEANS[FF]BENEATH THE PHANTOM'S CLOUD[FE]CASTLE, A BEANSTALK WILL GROW[FD][FB][04]INTO THE CLOUDS, CARRYING[FF]YOU WITH IT. THE CLOUDS HAVE[FE]MOVED OUT TO SEA, SO YOU[FD][FB][04]MUST PLANT THE SEEDS ON AN[FF]ISLAND IN THE OCEAN SO THAT[FE]THE BEANSTALK WILL GROW IN[FD][FB][04]THE RIGHT PLACE. THERE IS A[FF]STONE PYRAMID IN THE DESERT.[FE]THERE YOU WILL FIND THE MAGIC[FD][FB][04]CLOUD SHOES WHICH WILL HELP[FF]YOU WALK ON CLOUD VAPOR[FE]WITHOUT FALLING THROUGH.[FD][FB][04]YOU MAY NOT SEE AN ENTRANCE[FF]AT FIRST, BUT IF YOU TRY[FE]HARD AND USE YOUR HEAD, I'M[FD][FB][04][FB][05]SURE YOU WILL FIND IT.[FF]IF YOU SUCCEED, I PROMISE TO[FE][FB][06]REWARD YOU WITH A KISS.[FC]
2.translated: [FB][04]SI PLANTAS ESTAS JUDÍAS BAJO[FF]EL CASTILLO DE LAS NUBES DEL[FE]FANTASMA, CRECERÁ UNA PLANTA[FD][FB][04]GIGANTE HASTA LAS NUBES QUE[FF]TE LLEVARÁ CONSIGO.[FE]LAS NUBES SE HAN MOVIDO MAR[FD][FB][04]ADENTRO, ASÍ QUE DEBES[FF]PLANTAR LAS SEMILLAS EN UNA[FE]ISLA DEL MAR PARA QUE LA[FD][FB][04]PLANTA CREZCA EN EL SITIO[FF]CORRECTO. HAY UNA PIRÁMIDE[FE]DE PIEDRA EN EL DESIERTO.[FD][FB][04]ALLÍ ENCONTRARÁS LOS ZAPATOS[FF]MÁGICOS DE NUBES PARA[FE]CAMINAR SOBRE EL VAPOR SIN[FD][FB][04]CAERTE. PUEDE QUE AL[FF]PRINCIPIO NO VEAS LA[FE]ENTRADA, PERO SI TE[FD][FB][04][FB][05]ESFUERZAS, SEGURO QUE LA[FF]ENCUENTRAS. SI LO CONSIGUES,[FE][FB][06]TE PROMETO DARTE UN BESO.[FC]

3.original: [FB][04]THERE IS A STONE PYRAMID IN[FF]THE DESERT. THERE YOU WILL[FE]FIND THE MAGIC CLOUD SHOES[FD][FB][04]WHICH WILL HELP YOU WALK ON[FF]CLOUD VAPOR WITHOUT FALLING[FE]THROUGH.[FD][FB][04]YOU MAY NOT SEE AN ENTRANCE[FF]AT FIRST, BUT IF YOU TRY[FE]HARD AND USE YOUR HEAD, I'M[FD][FB][04][FB][05]SURE YOU WILL FIND IT.[FF]IF YOU SUCCEED, I PROMISE TO[FE][FB][06]REWARD YOU WITH A KISS.[FC]
3.translated: [FB][04]HAY UNA PIRÁMIDE DE PIEDRA[FF]EN EL DESIERTO. ALLÍ ESTÁN[FE]LOS ZAPATOS DE LAS NUBES.[FD][FB][04]TE PERMITEN CAMINAR SOBRE EL[FF]VAPOR DE LAS NUBES SIN[FE]CAERTE.[FD][FB][04]PUEDE QUE AL PRINCIPIO NO[FF]VEAS LA ENTRADA, PERO SI[FE]TE ESFUERZAS Y USAS LA[FD][FB][04][FB][05]CABEZA, SEGURO QUE LA[FF]ENCUENTRAS. SI LO CONSIGUES,[FE][FB][06]TE PROMETO UN BESO.[FC]

4.original: [FB][00]THIS FORTRESS GUARDS THE[FF]HARBOR, BUT THE BAD MAGIC[FE]HAD TURNED IT TO SAND.[FD][FF][FB][00]THANKS FOR RESCUING ME![FE][FD][FB][00][FB][01][FB][02][FB][03]LET ME GIVE YOU A SHIP FROM[FF]MY HARBOR TO HELP YOU REACH[FE]THE ISLAND.[FC]
4.translated: [FB][00]ESTA FORTALEZA PROTEGE EL[FF]PUERTO, PERO LA MAGIA[FE]MALVADA LO VOLVIÓ DE ARENA.[FD][FF][FB][00]¡GRACIAS POR RESCATARME![FE][FD][FB][00][FB][01][FB][02][FB][03]TE DOY UN BARCO EN MI PUERTO[FF]PARA QUE LLEGUES A LA ISLA.[FC]

5.original: [FB][00]LET ME GIVE YOU A SHIP FROM[FF][FB][01][FB][02]MY [FB][03]HARBOR TO HELP YOU REACH[FE]THE ISLAND.[FC]
5.translated: [FB][00]TE DOY UN BARCO EN MI PUERTO[FF][FB][01][FB][02][FB][03]PARA QUE LLEGUES A LA ISLA.[FC]

6.original: THE BAD MAGIC HAD ME TRAPPED[FF]IN MY OWN CASTLE![FE]THANKS FOR SETTIN' ME FREE.[FD]YOUR PATH LIES THROUGH A[FF]TINY CAVERN UP AHEAD, BUT,[FE]IN ORDER TO ENTER IT[FD]YOU HAVE TO SHRINK IN SIZE![FF]THERE'S A SHRINKING POTION[FE]IN THE CASTLE RUINS.[FD]NOW THAT THE FIRE IN MY[FF]CASTLE HAS WEAKENED, THE[FE]WATER IN THE LAKE HAS RISEN.[FD]YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO FIND A[FF]PASSAGE TO THE RUINS FROM[FE]THE LAKE.[FD][FB][11][FB][12]PLEASE ACCEPT [FB][13][FB][14][FB][16][FB][17]THIS MAGIC[FF]FLUTE. USE IT, AND IT WILL[FE]TAKE YOU BACK TO ANY PLACE[FD][FB][15][FF]YOU HAVE TRAVELLED BEFORE.[FE][FC]
6.translated: ¡LA MAGIA MALVADA ME TENÍA[FF]ATRAPADO EN MI CASTILLO![FE]GRACIAS POR LIBERARME.[FD]TU CAMINO PASA POR UNA[FF]CAVERNA ENANA, ¡PERO PARA[FE]PODER ENTRAR TIENES QUE[FD]ENCOGERTE![FF]HAY UNA POCIÓN MÁGICA EN LAS[FE]RUINAS DEL CASTILLO.[FD]AHORA QUE EL FUEGO DE MI[FF]CASTILLO ESTÁ DEBILITADO, EL[FE]AGUA DEL LAGO HA SUBIDO.[FD]DEBERÍAS PODER ENCONTRAR UN[FF]PASO A LAS RUINAS DESDE EL[FE]LAGO.[FD][FB][11][FB][12]ACEPTA POR FAVOR [FB][13][FB][14][FB][16][FB][17]ESTA FLAUTA[FF]MÁGICA. SI LA USAS TE[FE]SACARÁ DE CUALQUIER SITIO[FD][FB][15][FF]DONDE HAYAS ESTADO.[FE][FC]

7.original: YOUR PATH LIES THROUGH A[FF]TINY CAVERN UP AHEAD, BUT,[FE]IN ORDER TO ENTER IT[FD]YOU HAVE TO SHRINK IN SIZE![FF]THERE'S A SHRINKING POTION[FE]IN THE CASTLE RUINS.[FD]NOW THAT THE FIRE IN MY[FF]CASTLE HAS WEAKENED, THE[FE]WATER IN THE LAKE HAS RISEN.[FD]YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO FIND A[FF]PASSAGE TO THE RUINS FROM[FE]THE LAKE.[FC]
